title: Story: He found this one really great black turtleneck which he lov...
speaker: Steve Jobs
event: Man in the News: Steve Jobs
content: He found this one really great black turtleneck which he loved - I think it was Issey Miyake - so tried to buy another one and they didn't have any more. He called the company and asked if they would make another one, and they refused. So he said: 'Fine, how many do you have to make before I can buy them?' So they made them - I think he has a closet full of them.
